'''January 2000 San Antonio tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in San Antonio, Texas on 15 January 2000. [[Matt Lush]] won it. It is known from Matt Lush's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d176">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-15-san-antonio-texas-1-15-00d176/ san-antonio-texas-1-15-00], DeckTech (Matt "Old Skooler" Lush, 15 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-15-san-antonio-texas-1-15-00d176/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 January 2000
* '''Site:''' San Antonio, Texas
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Lush]]
